notes.title: ZAAM is out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35733052/525b452303dc36fa4e01ae67c1e2cc2dd3d737a2.jpg[/img]

ZAAM is a first-person psychological thriller horror game. Your Little girl Lucy has gone missing. As you search for answers in the surreal environment, a dark and ominous truth will come forth. If you're interested in playing, it's 15% off! Check it out!

notes.title: ZAAM Launches August 13th!
notes.content: Whoo! ZAAM is launching on August 13th! Play in a creepy, beautiful, nightmarish wonderland and discover the truth about Lucy! After several years of production, I can't tell you how proud I am of what we've made. It's creepy, it's atmospheric, and most importantly, I think it's especially meaningful. Discover the mystery on August 13th!
